name: 2c_charge_rest
description: CC-CV charge at 2C to 4.2 V, then rest at zero current for 1 hour
comment: Charge at 2C until 4.2 V, hold 4.2 V while the current tapers, finish at 0.05C, then log 1 hour of rest (change rest_after_s for longer or shorter). max_duration_s limits the charge phase only. No cell is named: pick it when launching.
